thread:
jordan: Customer reported: after transferring org ownership, they accepted the invite to Project 'acme-payments' but see a 403 in the console: "You do not have permission to view this project." They can still call the API with their API key.

maria: Oh. Do we have the org id and user email? any screenshots?

jordan: org=org_0a1b2c, project=proj_9z8y7x, user=user@acme.com. Attached screenshot shows the console error. Customer says they had Admin in previous org and expected roles to carry over.

kevin: Two quick suspects: (1) SCIM/group-to-role mapping changed during transfer -> user in idp group that no longer maps to project role; (2) inherited deny flag from old org mapping.

maria: Also check SSO claim rename. We've seen SAML assertion rename (e.g., claim 'roles' -> 'entitlements') cause mapping to drop.

jordan: I pulled audit logs, here's the relevant CLI filter I used:
```
redwoodctl audit logs --org org_0a1b2c --user user@acme.com --since 24h | grep role
```
Found an entry: "role_remap: scim_group->project_view removed by system during transfer" at 1718499900.

sre-oncall: Can we repro quickly by impersonating the user? If yes, check the /v1/console/authorize endpoint response for claims. Example curl:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/admin/impersonate \
  -d '{"org":"org_0a1b2c","user":"user@acme.com"}' | jq .
```
Look for `claims.roles` and `scim_groups` fields.

kevin: Workaround for now: add user as explicit project admin (via admin UI or `redwoodctl org add-member --org org_0a1b2c --project proj_9z8y7x --role admin --user user@acme.com`). That should unblock them while we fix mapping. Note: avoid doing this if customer is in a locked compliance org; confirm before mutating.

maria: If mapping is wrong, do a resync of SCIM groups and role mappings:
```
curl -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  https://api.redwood.inference/v1/admin/orgs/org_0a1b2c/scim/resync
```
This triggers a full group->role reconciliation. Propagation can take up to ~2 minutes.

jordan: Customer tried re-invite -> did not help. They accepted a second invite and still 403.

support_lead: Escalating to eng-identity. Please include audit snippet and impersonation output. Also add a support ticket link and mark priority P2.

maria: Noted. I see in infra logs that during the transfer we set `inheritance_block` for org_0a1b2c to prevent accidental role bleed. That flag may have persisted on child projects. I'll remove the flag on proj_9z8y7x if you confirm it's safe.

kevin: Quick check: run `redwoodctl org get --org org_0a1b2c --include-inheritance` and verify `inheritance_block=false` for the project. If true -> set to false.

jordan: Customer ok with a fix. I'll schedule maintenance window.

maria: After resync and clearing inheritance block, ask the user to hard-refresh and try incognito. Also advise them to clear any cached session tokens.

support_lead: Thanks team. If eng-identity needs more time, apply the explicit project admin workaround and document the change in the ticket. :thumbsup:

kevin: Follow-up: added a short-run playbook to the ticket for on-call to run the resync and inheritance-check commands.

jordan: I'll update the customer and close once they confirm access.
